verdict.rationale: Khoj lets privacy-conscious users self-host on their own hardware so data never leaves their device/region (khoj-docs-3, khoj-docs-38), which effectively gives full control over data location. However, there is no explicit region/residency selection feature for Khoj Cloud or documented multi-region hosting options. missing for 10: explicit region-selection controls for the hosted/cloud offering, documentation of where cloud data is stored, and independent verification of self-host data residency claims.
